text:
Priya (People Ops): Quick heads-up — I'm assembling a paste-ready 'self-review + peer feedback' quick pack managers can drop into Slack. Goal: make it super skimmable for ICs and reduce back-and-forth. Thoughts?
Marcus (Eng Manager): Love it. Keep it to 3–4 micro-prompts: impact, blockers, ask. Short.
Sam (Lead): +1. Add one line for evidence and one for 'why this mattered' (1 sentence).
Priya (People Ops): Good call. Draft below — please scan for clarity.
Priya (People Ops): ```
Manager paste (self-review prompts)
- Objective snapshot (1 line): what you set out to do
- Signal of impact (1–2 lines): metric/customer outcome or example
- Evidence (1 line): link to PR/metric/report or concrete example
- Roadblocks (1 sentence)
- Next ask (1 line): what you need from manager/org

Peer feedback quick prompts (paste to peers)
- One thing that stood out (1 line)
- Short example (1 line)
- One constructive suggestion (1 line)
```
Elena (HR): This is great. Can we add a D&I / cross-team prompt? Something like 'Cross-team contribution (1 line)'.
Priya (People Ops): Done — added: 'Cross-team contribution (1 line)'. Also creating a TL;DR single-line template managers can paste for execs.
Priya (People Ops): `TL;DR: {objective} — {impact} — {1 ask}`
Marcus (Eng Manager): Could you give a filled example so managers can just copy?
Priya (People Ops): Sure. `TL;DR: Launch pricing A/B to reduce churn — 8% drop in weekly churn by week 3 — ask: product + growth time to rollout to EU`
Sam (Lead): Also recommend a one-sentence coach DM managers can send before review: `Want me to read a draft before you submit?` Helps reduce last-minute rewrites.
Marcus (Eng Manager): Nice. Also please include explicit word limits: 'Keep each bullet <= 200 characters' and deadline reminder: 'Submit by EOD Friday'.
Priya (People Ops): Will add word limits and a calendar reminder blurb. Thinking of a short checklist managers can paste into team threads: `Checklist before submit: 1) TL;DR present 2) Evidence linked 3) Peer feedback requested 4) One ask`
Elena (HR): Can you include a micro-template for anonymous peer feedback routing? e.g., link to form + copyable prompt.
Priya (People Ops): Yep — will include the form link and a copy-paste DM for peers. Draft of DM: `Hey — can you give me 2 quick lines of feedback on X? Prefer concrete example + one suggestion. Thanks!`
Marcus (Eng Manager): Perfect. One more ask: add a one-liner managers can use in calibration to summarize level/rating rationale. Something like `Level snapshot + 1-line rationale`.
Priya (People Ops): Added: `Calibration line: {level} — {1-line rationale} (evidence link)`
OKR-bot: Reminder set for deadline 1843580000
Priya (People Ops): I'll tidy this into a paste-ready JSON/code block and drop in #docs + the performance priming kit. Will also create a short internal demo for managers next Wed (10 min).
Marcus (Eng Manager): :thumbsup: Thanks Priya — this will make the cycle way smoother.
Sam (Lead): Thanks — concise and practical.
Priya (People Ops): Thanks all — I'll post the final pack tomorrow morning. :tada:
